    def __init__(self, canvas, x):
        self.canvas = canvas
        self.id = canvas.create_rectangle(x, (HEIGHT - PADDLE_H) // 2,
                                          x + PADDLE_W, (HEIGHT + PADDLE_H) // 2,
                                          fill=WHITE, outline=WHITE)
        self.score = 0

    def move(self, dy):
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.id)
        y1 = max(0.0, min(HEIGHT - PADDLE_H, y1 + dy))
        self.canvas.coords(self.id, x1, y1, x2, y1 + PADDLE_H)

    @property

class Ball:
    def __init__(self, canvas):

        self.id = canvas.create_oval(0, 0, 0, 0, fill=WHITE, outline=WHITE)
        self.reset(random.choice([-1, 1]))

        self.x = WIDTH / 2 - BALL_SIZE / 2
        self.y = HEIGHT / 2 - BALL_SIZE / 2
        self.vx = BALL_SPEED * direction
        self.vy = random.choice([-1, 1]) * random.uniform(1.5, 4.5)
        self._render()

    def _render(self):

                           self.x + BALL_SIZE, self.y + BALL_SIZE)
